content:
Generate a detailed character sheet in GPT Image 2 (turnarounds, expression sheet, costume/accessory close-ups, action poses, props, palette, typography/layout) and then use that design as the visual basis for Seedance 2 animation.

Use style anchors in your prompt to lock the “Eastern action” look (cinematic anime-inspired kung fu concept art, ink-wash/watercolor texture, minimalist parchment background, soft monochrome earth-tone palette, premium ArtStation/AAA presentation).

Specify exact wardrobe, age, and pose details (e.g., 5-year-old Wing Chun prodigy, white kung fu jacket with frog buttons, loose black pants, wrist wraps, Wing Chun guard stance) to keep character consistency across frames.

Include a negative prompt targeting common failure modes (blurry/low quality, bad anatomy/extra fingers, distorted hands/pose, messy composition, flat lighting) and exclude unwanted styles (cyberpunk/neon, sci‑fi armor, chibi, modern streetwear, horror).
